line: IPEX (u.FL) to SMA female bulkhead pigtail, 10 to 15 cm
role: bringing module antennas out to SMA on E22-900M22S, Ra-01SH and any board with an IPEX jack only
spec: IPEX1 plug (the small 2 mm u.FL connector used on E22-900M22S and Ra-01SH) on RG1.13 or RG178 coax, 10 to 15 cm, terminated in a true SMA female bulkhead jack with nut and washer (marked SMA-K or SMA-KY, centre socket) so an SMA male antenna screws straight on; RP-SMA female has a centre pin and must be avoided
why: The SX1262 modules only expose a u.FL jack, so the antenna has to be brought out to a panel SMA before any attenuator or external whip can be fitted.
